slot.brief: Series LCR circuit at resonance with given R, L, C; express the quality factor Q symbolically and/or compute it, testing the ω0L/R form.

stem: A series LCR circuit has $R=10\ \text{\Omega}$, $L=0.5\ \text{H}$ and $C=50\ \mu\text{F}$. Its quality factor at resonance is:
working:
$\omega_0=1/\sqrt{LC}=200\ \text{rad s}^{-1}$; $Q=\omega_0L/R=(200)(0.5)/10=10$.

Independent check: At resonance, Q = (1/R)√(L/C) = (1/10)√(0.5/(50×10⁻⁶)) = 10.
solution:
For a series LCR circuit, $Q=\frac{\omega_0L}{R}$, where $\omega_0=\frac{1}{\sqrt{LC}}$.
$$\omega_0=\frac{1}{\sqrt{(0.5)(50\times10^{-6})}}=200\ \text{rad s}^{-1},\qquad Q=\frac{(200)(0.5)}{10}=10.$$
